title: LeCellModel: Interpretable Density Estimation over the Gene Expression Manifold
abstract: arXiv:2611.30955v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Representation learning for single-cell RNA-seq has been evaluated by the identities representations capture -- cell types, lineages, perturbations -- rather than how faithfully they model the distribution of cell states on the gene expression manifold. As a result, density estimation, rare-state detection, perturbation scoring, and gene-level attribution are bolted onto frozen embeddings as separate models, disconnected from the geometry of the data. We argue that modeling the distribution of cell states should be the primary objective, and that representation quality follows from it. Building on LeJEPA, whose SIGReg objective enforces a provably optimal isotropic Gaussian latent, we introduce LeCellModel, which reads the encoder's Jacobian log-volume (JEPA-SCORE) under this Gaussian latent as a relative typicality score. translated_title: LeCellModel：基因表达流形上的可解释密度估计
translated_abstract: 单细胞RNA测序的表征学习一直以表征所捕获的身份属性——细胞类型、谱系、扰动——来评估，而不是以它们对基因表达流形上细胞状态分布建模的忠实程度来评估。因此，密度估计、稀有状态检测、扰动打分和基因水平归因等方法只能作为独立模型附加到冻结的嵌入上，与数据本身的几何结构脱节。我们认为，对细胞状态分布的建模应当是首要目标，而表征质量应由此自然衍生。基于LeJEPA——其SIGReg目标可强制实现可证明最优的各向同性高斯潜空间——我们提出了LeCellModel，在该高斯潜空间下读取编码器的雅可比对数体积（JEPA-SCORE）作为相对典型性得分。在多个数据集上，LeCellModel在衡量表征质量的scIB基准测试中优于现有方法。
tldr: 提出LeCellModel，基于各向同性高斯潜空间读取编码器的雅可比对数体积（JEPA-SCORE）作为典型性得分，实现基因表达流形上的可解释密度估计，并在scIB基准上优于现有方法。
en_tdlr: LeCellModel performs interpretable density estimation over the gene expression manifold by reading the encoder's Jacobian log-volume (JEPA-SCORE) under a provably optimal isotropic Gaussian latent, outperforming established methods on the scIB benchmark.
